text:
adele: Kicking off sunrise rollout. Manual override window 06:30 UTC. Plan: US canary -> EU canary -> APAC warmup. Need a quick capacity sweep and a thermal headroom read. Pin model v2.3.1 for EU canary. @deploy-bot start canary in us-east-1 with 5% traffic.

deploy-bot: [automated] Initiating canary: region=us-east-1 traffic=5% version=v2.3.1. Callbacks: /ops/deploy/1745556666

mohit: can someone paste current GPU pool utilization? want to confirm spare capacity before EU. also, what's the avg p99 latency for long prompts rn?

sre-oncall: us-east pools at 68% GPU, thermal headroom ~14%. p99 gen=210ms (short seq), 480ms (seq 1024). eu-west pools 55%, apac 42%. We have 2 nodes spare in eu-west-2.

jen: pin EU to v2.3.1 is good — note that v2.4 has tokenizer tweak that regresses certain anchors. I'll attach regression test results in a sec.

marco: rollback criteria suggestion: if error-rate >0.8% for 3 consecutive 5m windows OR p99 > 1.2s for 10m, trigger auto-rollback to v2.2.9 and drain new connections. Also add surge cap: stop promoting if burst > 150k rps across regions.

ops-runner: smoke test snippets: ```curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"input":"sanity check"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate``` run it 50x per region.

eva: release notes: call out tokenizer change and quantization fallback improvements, add contact: eng-releases@redwood.com. Change window: 06:30-07:30 UTC.

adele: thanks. @sre-oncall once us canary stable for 15m, promote to EU. If anything noisy, manual override will pause rollout.

deploy-bot: Canary health: 15m checkpoint - errors=0.12% p99=230ms token-rate stable. Marking stable -> promoting EU canary (5%).

sre-oncall: eu-west promotion allowed — starting warmup. Pre-warm: +2 nodes. Keep close watch on KV cache hit-rate.

mohit: running smoke tests now, posting quick results: us: 50/50 success, p99 220ms; eu: 48/50 success p99 260ms.

jen: observed low-level tokenization mismatch on 2/50 EU runs — will run focused eval. If >5% mismatch, rollback EU only.

adele: noted. Manual override available in deploy dashboard: Link: https://console.redwood.ai/deploys/1745556666 :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Promotion complete: EU canary at 5%. APAC warmup scheduled in 10m.

marco: if EU shows regressions, we will pin EU back to v2.2.9 and keep US running. Confirm runbook: ops-runner will flip traffic and notify CS.

ops-runner: ready for manual rollback. Acked.

eva: updating release notes + customer-facing blurb: 'minor tokenizer change — may affect anchor matching; we are monitoring.'

adele: final: keep chat here. If all green, full sweep at 07:00 UTC. thx all.
